claims.text: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach activities.
Supports members, individuals, and organizations to run projects connecting communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences.
Prioritizes projects that connect under-represented audiences with chemical science.
Prioritizes projects that develop members' engagement skills.
Prioritizes projects that support positive social outcomes.
Prioritizes projects that engage families/adults with chemistry.
The fund is open for applications throughout 2026.
The final deadline for applications is October 2, 2026, at 17:00 UK time.
There are three application rounds in 2026 with specific deadlines.
Projects must be completed by November 23, 2027, at the latest.
Applications are considered through a multistage process.
Feedback on funding decisions is provided to all applicants.
Applicants must be aged 18 and over.
Applicants must be a UK or Republic of Ireland (ROI) resident, or applying on behalf of an organization registered in the UK or ROI.
Applicants should not resubmit an unsuccessful Outreach Fund application unless invited to do so.
Applications must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
The fund aims to connect communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences.
The fund provides funding for schools and public groups without restriction on the type of audience.
The fund is particularly interested in funding work with under-represented groups including people with disabilities and those facing social, economic, and educational disadvantages.
Applications should clearly show how money will be spent and provide justification for spending.
Budgets must be considered with respect to projected project reach and impact.
High costs must be justified in terms of audience reach, audience needs, and/or impact.
Successful applicants will be asked to sign an agreement regarding the grant.
Successful applicants will be asked to raise an invoice for 80% of the total grant.
Successful applicants must submit an evaluation within two weeks of the completion of a project.
The final 20% of the grant will be awarded following a review of the evaluation.
Projects should not start before the outcome is communicated (seven weeks after the deadline).
Evaluation must be submitted by December 7, 2027.
